import math
t=math.radians(9)
assert abs(math.tan(4*t)*math.tan(6*t)-1)<1e-9
res=1/math.tan(5*t)
vals=[math.sqrt(3),-math.sqrt(3),-1,1]
assert abs(res-vals[3])<1e-9
for i in range(3): assert abs(res-vals[i])>1e-6

from fractions import Fraction as F

vals=[F(5,4)*60,55,48,F(5,3)*60]
assert res==vals[2]
for i in (0,1,3): assert res!=vals[i]
